description: Initial CobraBench weighted scoring configuration. Category detail is always retained; overall score is a derived summary only.
scoring_principles: Retain category-level scores; never reduce an evaluation to one unexplained number.
Separate objective measurements, rule-based checks, human judgments, and LLM-as-judge results.
Treat LLM-as-judge scores as advisory, never as unquestionable ground truth.
Preserve exact prompt, model revision, inference parameters, raw output, evaluator version, and rationale.
